implementation.proof_scope: Targeted independent source review, not a new global audit. Source continuity covers the current forward kernel and all 271 physical/numerical entries; root changes only describe fixed UQ conditions.

mechanisms.scope: State and cumulative ledgers carry continuously through all eight declared stages.
Shared chemical potentials and conjugate energy/entropy terms; no extra fictitious bound-water mass.
Current inventories, atom-balanced root stoichiometry and gas sources; reversible carbonate and competing carbonization.
Shared species/enthalpy/entropy fluxes, Darcy and positive symmetric gas-pair mobility.
Same Helmholtz potential and current composition/phase derivatives.
Effective disordered-state proxy with phase energy/entropy and carrier birth, not a mineral phase diagram.
Dry/water/phase/temperature conductivity and pore radiation use the existing shared heat flux.

current_all_eight_stage_wiring.source: P05 completed full-cycle runs, no additional integration

P05.range_qualification: Only the declared 25-dimensional paired ensemble. Fixed assumptions and their correlations are not range-validated.
P05.ranking_scope: All 24 physical solutions passed, but 9 process endpoint failures remain. Six metrics have no proven robust winner; residual-carbon and peak-temperature-difference median ties must not be used as an ordering claim.

independent_readback.method: Independent reader recalculated new saved records only; no integrations, old arithmetic or software tests rerun.

P05.standard_python_api: sludge_vme.uq.full_cycle.compare(config, out); execution used the same paired design and summarize_comparison with independent processes.

joint_drying.scope: Drying window only; no cooled-product or nominal-process qualification.

evidence_limitations: Noise-free same-model same-discretization demonstrations; no real-material accuracy, noise robustness or global uniqueness.
Two resistance parameters fixed at nominal one; no range or identifiability qualification.
Full truth retains physical boolean, maximum balance residual and endpoints, not an independently reread detailed full-truth budget.

Original per-call gas_ledger_present=False is an invalid recorder probe in whole_cycle; the actual ledger is at report top level. Original records preserved; P01/P05 separately establish ledger wiring.

source_cli_startup.scope: Parser/source-checkout startup only; no integration and not a substitute for physical acceptance.

documentation_independent_review.scope: CLI exit semantics, nine observation definitions/units, source entrypoint and separation of physical/process/material/backup evidence; no broad audit or rerun.

P02.scope_review: Targeted independent source review; existing approximate full-cycle coupling is complete. Excluded mechanisms and material validation remain separate.

P08.decision: Approximate model capability and declared physical/numerical acceptance complete; nominal process acceptance failed; material applicability and real-world comparison pending measurements.

criteria.scope: P01 dynamic window plus 24 complete P05 cycles
Unchanged forward kernel and current successful physical audits; source continuity and inherited mechanism-level proofs
Inherited unchanged nominal forward kernel, not new runs or parameter-range convergence
25 dimensions, 8 paired samples, 3 scenarios, 72 fixed conditions
